findings.value: A cider and perry shop in London Fields focused on British cider, with tastings on Fridays and Saturdays.

evidence.quote: Run by fine cider merchant Felix Nash, the Fine Cider Company specialises in British ciders and perries sourced from all over the country.
there are tastings held every Friday and Saturday where you can try over half a dozen styles
We specialise mainly in fine British ciders & perries

notes: London The Inside article (3 June 2026, updated 23 June 2026) and the shop's own Ticket Tailor page were read; the article's 'perfect place to shop these bottles' is its opinion and is not used. No review or other press article found in one WebSearch. The Ticket Tailor event page states an age limit (strictly 18+), which belongs to the facts aspect. No status news.
